title: galium bungei var. hispidum
intro: Galium bungei var. hispidum, commonly known as Himalayan bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan bedstraw are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan bedstraw have been found to include flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercetin, and isorhapontigenin, as well as phenolic acids like ellagic acid and ferulic acid.
